goals.statement: Build functional AI agents using large-language models, tool-calling, memory, planning, and environment loops.
Connect agents to multimodal inputs such as vision, audio, wearables, or interaction traces.
Design and evaluate agent environments, benchmarks, simulations, and failure cases.
Understand techniques for improving agent performance, including fine-tuning, reinforcement learning approaches such as GRPO, preference optimization, and iterative evaluation.
Prototype agents within a chosen domain that could include games, robotics, software control, organizations, personal productivity, education, and cognitive augmentation.
Critically analyze the effects of AI agents on human cognition, agency, learning, overreliance, and social behavior.
Design agents that augment human capabilities rather than simply automate human tasks.
